svg.title: A 7/1 ARM's rate paths
svg.desc: The reference loan as a 7/1 ARM holds 6% for 84 payments. Expecting 7.5% with 5/2/5 caps, it resets to 7.5% ($1,365.01). In the worst case it jumps to 11% ($1,787.42). Expecting 2% with 2/2/5 caps and a 2.75% margin, it falls to 4% and then stops at the 2.75% floor ($881.34).

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A 7/1 ARM: three ways the rate can go
